user.title: Connect to MikroTik Manager
user.description: Enter your server URL. Your browser will open MikroTik Manager to sign in and authorize read-only access. Home Assistant can display only devices your account can access.

reauth_confirm.title: Reconnect MikroTik Manager
reauth_confirm.description: Sign in again to restore read-only access to your devices.

error.invalid_url: Enter an HTTPS server URL without a path, credentials, query or fragment.
error.unsupported_server: This server does not support the required MikroTik Manager OAuth connection.
error.cannot_connect: Could not connect to the server. Check its URL and try again.

abort.read_only_required: Select read-only access on the MikroTik Manager authorization page. The broader connection was refused.
abort.unique_id_mismatch: The authorization does not match the existing connection.
abort.missing_configuration: Enter the MikroTik Manager server URL to begin.
abort.authorize_url_timeout: The server did not respond in time while starting authorization.
abort.authorize_rejected: Authorization was cancelled. You can start the connection again.
abort.no_url_available: Home Assistant has no available callback URL. See the [instructions]({docs_url}).
abort.oauth_unauthorized: Authorization has expired or was revoked. Sign in again.
abort.oauth_failed: Authorization could not be completed. Check the server connection and try again.
abort.user_rejected_authorize: Authorization was cancelled. You can start the connection again.
abort.oauth_error: The server returned an invalid authorization response.
abort.oauth_timeout: The server did not respond in time while completing authorization.
